translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: An daksabalid, nibneggi ibmar-wilubgan-dummarbad, degine, geger-dakleged: Angermar-walagugle boni-sogagugle napi sedimalad, ar ade Bab-Dummad-bela-bela-nue-urwed ase bergumaid.

An daksabalid, demar ispeyob dakleged, sooba-oburaled. Degine, dulemar ibdulagi, degine, e-wilub-sobaledgine obichamaladi, degine, e-wilub-naid, degine, e-ebised-naidgi obichamaladi, demar-ispebi-dakleged-birgi gwichimalad, gar-arpa Bab-Dummad-ega-uksad gani-gwichimalad.
Amar epenne-Moisés, Bab-Dummadga-arbaed, e-namaksad namakbukwad, degine, Sibad-Wawaad-Mimmigi-namaklegedgi namakbukmalad. Soge an itosad:

content.text: degine, doa be-nug ogannogosur be itoge?
ar ade be igar-inikigwad-imaked be oyononikid.

content: We-ibmarmar-gusad-sorba an atakdegu, an daksad, nibneggi Bab-Dummad-maid-neg-argade. We-negde Bab-Dummad-Israel-dulemar-na-ebo-igar-mesisad-negad.

Bab-Dummad-maid-neggi angermar-walagugled bonigan-bulegan-sogagugle-nika ainiarmalad. A-angermarde mola-sibu-ollibisulid-nuedi, ibyegwichi-yoi noarmalad, degine, sadergi-naguedi ber olobi binasgargi naimarbalid.
Ibdula-walabakegwad-wargwen, angermar-walagugledga olo-noga-gwagugle uksad. We-olo-nogamar Bab-Dummad-gusgu-degi-sadegu-dula-gudiguad-e-urwed ena bukwad.

Degine, Bab-Dummad-maid-neg waa ena sigisad, Bab Dummad na yeer-dakleged-nikadba, degine, na e-gangued nikadba, dulemar gege Bab-Dummad-maid-negse doged, bela bonigan-sogagugle angermar-walagugle-sediid berguedse.
